title: Knowledge-Centric Automated Issue Resolution: A Systematic Survey and Taxonomy
abstract: arXiv:2611.18569v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated issue resolution is a knowledge-intensive software maintenance task in which LLM-based agents must acquire, represent, use, and update knowledge from repositories, execution environments, historical artifacts, documents, tools, and prior repair processes. This paper presents a systematic survey of 133 studies on automated issue resolution from a knowledge-centric perspective. We introduce a three-layer taxonomy that organizes issue-resolution knowledge into the Background Knowledge Layer, the Repository Knowledge Layer, and the Procedural Knowledge Layer, and analyze the knowledge lifecycle along six dimensions: knowledge types, sources and extraction methods, representation formats, usage methods, workflow stages, and temporal evolution. Our analysis shows that current systems primarily rely on Existing Code Knowledge and Development Tool Knowledge, while Repository Evolution Knowledge and Experiential Knowledge are increasing

translated_title: 以知识为中心的自动化问题解决：系统性综述与分类体系
translated_abstract: 自动化问题解决是一项知识密集型的软件维护任务，基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体必须从代码仓库、执行环境、历史产物、文档、工具以及先前修复过程中获取、表示、使用和更新知识。本文从以知识为中心的视角对133项关于自动化问题解决的研究进行了系统性综述。我们提出了一个三层分类体系，将问题解决所需知识组织为背景知识层、仓库知识层和过程知识层，并从知识类型、来源与提取方法、表示格式、使用方法、工作流阶段以及时间演化六个维度分析了知识生命周期。我们的分析表明，当前系统主要依赖现有代码知识和开发工具知识，而对仓库演化知识和经验性知识的关注正在不断上升。
tldr: 本文对133项自动化问题解决研究进行了以知识为中心的系统性综述，提出了由背景知识层、仓库知识层和过程知识层构成的三层知识分类体系，并从六个维度分析了知识生命周期，发现当前系统主要依赖现有代码知识和开发工具知识。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a knowledge-centric systematic survey of 133 studies on automated issue resolution, introducing a three-layer taxonomy (Background, Repository, and Procedural Knowledge) and analyzing the knowledge lifecycle across six dimensions, revealing that current systems primarily rely on existing code knowledge and development tool knowledge.
